reason: Retire the live test dependency on generated compatibility transport before browser cutover. Preserve synchronous VM APIs, canonical ESM class identity, realm isolation and every existing game-cycle/check fixture. Cold startup transfers disposable resources to Application only after success; failed composition releases already constructed input/inventory/DOM resources. DEV restart, pending-build pagehide, metadata abort and drag timer cleanup become explicit.

ownership.testRuntime: One module namespace cache per VM, test-only path aliases, explicit test stub contracts. No generated runtime or transport global. Evidence trace probe receives native namespaces directly without global publication.
ownership.startup: Cold resource ownership transfers on successful construction. Application dispose is idempotent; each DEV startup resets only its own singleton promise. Existing platform handles are cleared by identity.
ownership.interface: Startup owns its engine styles, contextmenu/touchstart/DOMContentLoaded listeners. No cumulative listeners on restart.
ownership.metadata: DEV tools and overlay cancel owned metadata requests and ignore late results; disposed panel cannot rebuild.
ownership.drag: DEV tools owns UIDraggableButton and cancels its pending hold timer and element/pointer listeners.
